ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets rallied strongly on the Delta India exchange, with BTC up 5.6% to $85,009 and other majors posting double‑digit gains, driven by bullish technicals and fresh institutional interest. The surge is reinforced by recent news of a short‑squeeze pushing BTC past $85k and the ECB’s launch of the Pontes platform for tokenized asset settlement, indicating growing mainstream adoption. New token listings on Delta India add liquidity but volume focus remains on BTC and emerging assets like NEAR.
